theme.title: Around the League
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did Chris Paul average for New Orleans in 2007–08?
questions.note: 11.6 a game, plus 2.71 steals, as New Orleans won 56 games.

funFacts.text: Paul also averaged 2.71 steals per game.
He started all eighty regular-season games he played.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chris Paul | 80 | 80 | 37.6

questions.prompt: Shaquille O'Neal averaged 38.0 points in the 2000 Finals. What did his Miami teammate Dwyane Wade average as 2006 Finals MVP?
questions.note: 34.7 a game, as Miami came back from 0–2 down to win the franchise's first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Averaging 34.7 points per game in the series

funFacts.text: Miami came back from 0–2 down to win the series in six games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Heat overcame a two-games-to-none series deficit to defeat the Mavericks in six games

funFacts.text: Behind Wade's 36 points, Miami rallied from a 14-point first-half deficit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Behind Dwyane Wade's 36 points, Miami rallied from a 14-point first-half deficit

funFacts.text: That Finals victory delivered the first NBA championship in Heat franchise history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first NBA championship in franchise history

questions.prompt: The 1987 Lakers lost one game in the West playoffs, when Sleepy Floyd scored how many in Oakland?
questions.context: 1987 West semifinals · Game 4 · Warriors vs Lakers
questions.note: 51, sparing Golden State a sweep; it was the only game the 1987 Lakers lost in the West.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their only loss was a Sleepy Floyd 51-point outburst in Game 4 in Oakland

funFacts.text: The Lakers swept Denver in the opening round, starting their Western playoff run without a loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they swept the Denver Nuggets in the first round

funFacts.text: Floyd's outburst allowed Golden State to avoid a second-round sweep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: which allowed the Warriors to avoid a sweep

funFacts.text: Michael Cooper set a playoff mark with six made three-pointers against Boston in the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hit six 3 pointers, a playoff record

questions.prompt: Cleveland's 49-point first quarter in 2017 set the Finals record for a period. How many did Portland score in a 1977 Finals third quarter?
questions.context: 1977 NBA Finals · Game 4 · vs Philadelphia, at Portland
questions.note: 41 in the third quarter, as Portland squared the series 2–2 on its way to the title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Portland quickly led the game by 17 points and never looked back, scoring 41 points in the third quarter

funFacts.text: Lionel Hollins was Portland's top scorer in Game 4, producing 25 points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Pts: Hollins 25

funFacts.text: Walton picked up his fifth foul during the third quarter and spent much of the second half on the bench.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Walton committing his fifth foul midway through the third and being on the bench

funFacts.text: The win tied the series at 2–2.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Series tied, 2–2

questions.prompt: The chart shows four other playoff comebacks. When the Clippers stunned the Warriors in 2019 Game 2, how far behind had they fallen?
questions.context: Los Angeles Clippers at Warriors · 2019 first round
questions.note: 31 points: down 94–63 in the third quarter, L.A. outscored the champions 72–37 the rest of the way.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: overcoming a 31-point deficit, the largest comeback in NBA playoff history.

funFacts.text: The comeback began after the Clippers fell far behind late in the third quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Clippers trailed 94–63 with 7:31 remaining in the third quarter of Game 2.

funFacts.text: Los Angeles overwhelmed Golden State on the scoreboard afterward.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They would go on to outscore Golden State 72–37 en route to overcoming a 31-point deficit

funFacts.text: The Clippers pulled off their upset against the defending champions.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In Game 2 of their series against the reigning champion Golden State Warriors
